paper_metadata.title: A High-Performance Very Low-Voltage Current Sense Amplifier for Nonvolatile Memories
paper_metadata.abstract: A high-performance sense amplifier for nonvolatile memories capable of working under a very low-voltage power supply is presented. The topology of the sense amplifier uses a pure current-mode comparison allowing power supplies lower than 1 V to be used and includes two subcircuits which improve slew rate performance. The sense amplifier was implemented in an EEPROM realized with a 0.18m EEPROM technology. Experimental results showed a read access time of about 30 ns with a power supply of 1.65 V.
